regime_context: Detector shows a narrow, gold-led tape with AI-compute as an uncrowded challenger, but for China A-shares the one validated edge (absolute-trend gate) did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false) and cross-sectional momentum has rank-IC ~0, so this is display-only, not alpha. With rotation breadth only 8/22 eligible and a near-zero-ranked, mean-reverting broad tape, I have low directional confidence and will express mostly conditional, low-conviction leans rather than a strong view.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners' thin and non-scorable leadership broadens beyond the narrative name itself: if the rotation breadth (currently 8/22) expands above ~0.5 with Gold holding rank 1, the gold-led resource tape would confirm; if Gold slips in score while AI-compute's breadth (0.118) rises above ~0.3, the leadership handoff would be confirmed and this watch would retire.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Among scorable, trend-tagged themes, Industrial Metals has the strongest durability_bar (0.77) with solid breadth (0.769), suggesting a more intact trend than the other eligible resources names. This is a relative-durability read, NOT a return forecast — the absolute-trend gate has no validated edge here, so the only question is whether the trend is healthy enough to avoid a shake-out.
theses.dissent: In a mean-reverting China tape the trend gate historically whipsaws, so a high durability score can mark the late, top-heavy phase of the move just as easily as a continuation.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS breaks below its 50-day average before the check-by date.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI-compute scores high (1.555) and is not crowded (crowding_z -0.56), and it is the only non-resources theme in the top of the eligible list. However its durability_bar is weak (0.46) and breadth extremely thin (0.118), which in a gates-off market means momentum is mostly a focus signal, not a reason to add.
theses.dissent: The macro headline flow is dominated by ai_tech (n=39 of 65), which often marks attention spikes that top rather than a durable trend; thin breadth means the theme is a few names, not a coherent sector.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS underperforms the CSI 300 by more than 3% over the next 10 sessions.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma/CXO is crowded (crowding_z 1.45, crowded=true) and has a mediocre durability_bar (0.57) with mid breadth (0.429). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade, so the clean directional expression is to avoid initiating, not to short.
theses.dissent: Crowding is coincident and can persist in a momentum tape; avoiding it may simply miss further upside if the theme continues to attract flows.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ makes a new 20-day high while staying above its 50-day average before the check-by date.
